publisher: New Jersey Department of Children and Families Office of Licensing

official_sources.evidence: DCF licenses centers serving six or more children and distinguishes voluntarily registered family child-care homes.
The 2026-10-01 roster publishes license number, provider type and name, street address, ZIP, phone, email, ages served, and licensed capacity for licensed centers.
The NJ Open Data Center provides a supported Socrata API contract for Licensed Child Care Centers; its temporal currency must be assessed separately from the newer DCF roster.
The state catalog attributes the statewide, ongoing explorer to DCF Office of Licensing with on-demand/as-needed collection and posting.

scope.warning: Roster presence, three-year license term, inspection, violation, family-home registration, and current operation are separate assertions.

temporal.limitation: The dated DCF roster is newer than the separately cataloged open-data presentation; API and roster currency must be reconciled before acquisition or promotion.

next_action: Validate the current Socrata schema and row/pagination contract against the 2026-10-01 DCF center roster without acquiring provider rows; preserve center-only scope and admit only after temporal, reuse, and conservation review.
